merchants.name: Izzio
merchants.finite_stock_note: sells the objects it is actually holding (vbSellFromInventory on Izzio), up to 25 at a time. It can be OUT of something, and it can be too FULL to buy from you — it refuses per item, out loud, with no error on the wire. Read the purse afterwards; do not trust the call.

merchants.name: Pacal ix'Anoak
merchants.finite_stock_note: sells the objects it is actually holding (vbSellFromInventory on KocatanShopkeeper), up to 25 at a time. It can be OUT of something, and it can be too FULL to buy from you — it refuses per item, out loud, with no error on the wire. Read the purse afterwards; do not trust the call.

merchants.name: Fehr'loi Qan
merchants.also_note: answers to the same name but draws differently, so probably a different person — still a second place to buy the same things.

merchants.name: Jonas D'Accor
merchants.also_note: the same man under another class — same name, same icon. One of these usually stands still.
